Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

• Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.

• Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

Headquarters: Germany (Remote); Poland (Remote); Romania (Remote); Spain (Remote)

At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

• Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.

• CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.

• Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.

• Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

• Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems

• Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform

• Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience

• Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code

• Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security

• Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost

• Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

• Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy

• Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement

• Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

• Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design

• Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers

• Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

• Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption

• Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost

• Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

The interview process

• Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role

• Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.

• System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice

• DDSA (45 min): A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.

• Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values

• Offer 

Being part of Ledgy means

• Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.

• We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.

• This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.

Per the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the pay range for this role is listed below for all legally required countries. Pay within the range reflects your skills, experience and the scope of the role, and is set using objective criteria applied consistently across the team. Certain roles are also eligible for additional rewards including variable pay under the applicable plan. Ledgy offers equity through our employee option plan. Benefits offered vary by country and type of employment.
Spain pay range
€79.000—€97.000 EUR

About the company
We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.
We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.
Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.
Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role
We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.
You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.
You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities
• 
Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.
• 
Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.
• 
Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.
• 
Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.
• 
Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.
• 
Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.
• 
Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.
• 
Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.
• 
Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements
• 
4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• 
Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).
• 
Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.
• 
Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.
• 
Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.
• 
Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.
• 
Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have
• 
Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.
• 
Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.
• 
Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.
• 
Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.
• 
Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.
• 
Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.
• 
Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.

Headquarters: Denmark; Finland; Latvia; Lithuania; Netherlands; Remote; Spain; Tallinn, Harju, Estonia
 
URL: http://bondora.group

At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a CRM Manager, you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.

• Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.

• Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.

• Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.

• Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.

• Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.

• Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.

• Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.

• Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.

• Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).

• Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.

• Sound compliance judgment: transactional vs. promotional messages, consent, and responsible treatment of customers in a credit business.

• A habit of checking data before trusting it, and of fixing problems at the root.

• Working expertise in email, SMS and WhatsApp, with modular, localisable content for several markets.

• A habit of using AI to speed up QA and analysis, with the judgment to know when not to trust it.

• High ownership and a bias to action: you’d rather ship something good this week than something perfect next quarter, and you drive conversations with Product, Engineering, Legal and Risk toward decisions.

What can you expect at Bondora? 

• Contribute to Bondora’s ambitious goal of reaching 1BN in revenue. Your skills and efforts will directly impact our growth trajectory and shape the future of our company.

• Our employees deserve the best. We recognize our people with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package (5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental healthcare support, share options and much more!)

• We provide an environment that encourages your personal and professional growth. As we constantly evolve and innovate, you’ll have endless opportunities (and budget) to expand your skills and skyrocket your career.

The next steps

If you have the guts, ideas, and a team vision, apply now! 

Our hiring process:

2️⃣ Meet Mario, CMO. 
3️⃣ Tackle a home task to showcase your skills.
4️⃣ Complete our personality and logic assessments via Alva Labs.
5️⃣ Meet Pärtel Tomberg, our CEO.
6️⃣ Bar Raiser interview with Olga Kikas, our Chief of People.
7️⃣ 🎉 If the stars align — welcome to Bondora!

Join our team of Bondorians, and let's make it happen!

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Product Accounting team at Stripe supports products across Stripe by providing guidance on accounting implications and enabling teams to make informed strategic decisions. The team records business transactions accurately and on time in the balance sheet and income statement, and partners with cross-functional and international teams in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll do

Stripe is seeking an experienced accountant to join our world-class accounting team, focusing on products developed by our Bridge subsidiary. You’ll leverage your technical expertise with U.S. GAAP to identify accounting implications and customer impacts and advise cross-functional partners. You will be responsible for ensuring timely and accurate month-end close results for Bridge products, while also working on initiatives to create scalable accounting solutions.. 

Responsibilities

  • Plan and perform monthly close activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, analytic reviews, and financial reporting deliverables for Bridge products
  • Identify, recommend and implement scalable accounting processes to support global growth at Bridge
  • Partner with our business and finance teams to understand new products, features, and contracts, and advise on accounting implications
  • Partner with Internal Systems and Engineering teams to improve financial systems and automate accounting processes
  • Assess the effectiveness of internal controls and design processes and controls for emerging business activities
  • Understand data and system flows, analyzing financial results to identify and address anomalies.
  • Support external audit processes

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant public accounting and/or industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • Professional accountancy qualification, such as CA, CPA, ACA, ACCA, or CIMA
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and experience with internal controls
  • Experience with monthly or quarterly close processes, journal-entry preparation and posting, audits, regulatory reporting, financial-statement preparation, and accounting systems
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey financial concepts to both financial and non-financial audiences
  • Ability to structure ambiguous work and build systems and automation 
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders

 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in the technology or payments industry
  • Experience accounting for cryptocurrencies, including stablecoins
  • Experience with Oracle Suite
  • Experience with data-querying and analysis tools, including SQL
  • Exposure to relevant US GAAP standards, e.g. ASC 860, ASC 606, or ASC 326, is preferred.
